t: This Sylvania single 4ft LED batten provides efficient and bright lighting with 1920 lumens and a cool white 4000K colour temperature. It is an ideal replacement for older fluorescent T8 battens, suitable for various indoor applications such as workshops, garages, and utility rooms in both domestic and commercial settings. The batten features a durable steel body and a polycarbonate diffuser, ensuring robust performance. Installation is straightforward due to its push-in design, and fixings are supplied for ceiling-mounted fitting. With integrated LED technology, this 16W batten offers a long operational life of 25,000 hours.
b: Fixings Supplied for Convenient Ceiling-Mounted Fitting
Replaces Fluorescent T8 Battens with modern LED
